data.title: DNA Translation
data.statement:
mRNA sequences code for proteins. In an mRNA sequence, three nucleotides (three letters in the sequence) combine for one amino acid (one element in the protein sequence). mRNA begins coding the protein at the start codon, {{AUG}}, and ends at a stop codon, {{UAG}}, {{UAA}}, or {{UGA}}, without skipping any codons in between.

Output the protein sequence if there is one. If no protein sequence exists, output {{NONE}}. If the sequence exists but does not terminate properly, it is abnormal, so output {{ELIMINATE}}.

The <<first line of input>> consists of a string, [[h]], that includes all 64 codon combinations and what they code for separated by spaces formatted, {{codon}}<<:>>{{amino acid}}, so "UUU:Phe UUC:Phe UUA:Leu UUG:Leu UCU:Ser…". The <<second line of input>> will be a string, [[s]], that is the mRNA sequence beginning with a 5' Cap (m7Gppp) and ending with a Poly-A Tail (AAAA...), such as "m7GpppAUGUAGAAAAA".

Example Input:
UUU:Phe UUC:Phe UUA:Leu UUG:Leu UCU:Ser UCC:Ser UCA:Ser UCG:Ser UAU:Tyr UAC:Tyr UAA:STOP UAG:STOP UGU:Cys UGC:Cys UGA:STOP UGG:Trp CUU:Leu CUC:Leu CUA:Leu CUG:Leu CCU:Pro CCC:Pro CCA:Pro CCG:Pro CAU:His CAC:His CAA:Gln CAG:Gln CGU:Arg CGC:Arg CGA:Arg CGG:Arg AUU:Ile AUC:Ile AUA:Ile AUG:Met ACU:Thr ACC:Thr ACA:Thr ACG:Thr AAU:Asn AAC:Asn AAA:Lys AAG:Lys AGU:Ser AGC:Ser AGA:Arg AGG:Arg GUU:Val GUC:Val GUA:Val GUG:Val GCU:Ala GCC:Ala GCA:Ala GCG:Ala GAU:Asp GAC:Asp GAA:Glu GAG:Glu GGU:Gly GGC:Gly GGA:Gly GGG:Gly
m7GpppAUGUAGAAAAA

Example Output:
Met STOP

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

mRNA sequences code for proteins. In an mRNA sequence, three nucleotides (three letters in the sequence) combine for one amino acid (one element in the protein sequence). mRNA begins coding the protein at the start codon, AUG, and ends at a stop codon, UAG, UAA, or UGA, without skipping any codons in between.

Output the protein sequence if there is one. If no protein sequence exists, output NONE. If the sequence exists but does not terminate properly, it is abnormal, so output ELIMINATE.

The first line of input consists of a string, h, that includes all 64 codon combinations and what they code for separated by spaces formatted, codon:amino acid, so "UUU:Phe UUC:Phe UUA:Leu UUG:Leu UCU:Ser…". The second line of input will be a string, s, that is the mRNA sequence beginning with a 5' Cap (m7Gppp) and ending with a Poly-A Tail (AAAA...), such as "m7GpppAUGUAGAAAAA".

UUU:Phe UUC:Phe UUA:Leu UUG:Leu UCU:Ser UCC:Ser UCA:Ser UCG:Ser UAU:Tyr UAC:Tyr UAA:STOP UAG:STOP UGU:Cys UGC:Cys UGA:STOP UGG:Trp CUU:Leu CUC:Leu CUA:Leu CUG:Leu CCU:Pro CCC:Pro CCA:Pro CCG:Pro CAU:His CAC:His CAA:Gln CAG:Gln CGU:Arg CGC:Arg CGA:Arg CGG:Arg AUU:Ile AUC:Ile AUA:Ile AUG:Met ACU:Thr ACC:Thr ACA:Thr ACG:Thr AAU:Asn AAC:Asn AAA:Lys AAG:Lys AGU:Ser AGC:Ser AGA:Arg AGG:Arg GUU:Val GUC:Val GUA:Val GUG:Val GCU:Ala GCC:Ala GCA:Ala GCG:Ala GAU:Asp GAC:Asp GAA:Glu GAG:Glu GGU:Gly GGC:Gly GGA:Gly GGG:Gly
